sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.PimProductId AS productId, p.SKU AS sku, cf.ai AS additionalInfo, f1.k AS customField1Key, f1.v AS customField1Value FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p CROSS APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(fl.CustomKey, @keyValueSep, fl.CustomKeyValue), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.DisplayOrder, f.CustomCode) AS ai FROM dbo.ZnodePimCustomField f INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCustomFieldLocale fl ON fl.PimCustomFieldId = f.PimCustomFieldId AND fl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE f.PimProductId = p.PimProductId) cf OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 fl.CustomKey AS k, fl.CustomKeyValue AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimCustomField f INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCustomFieldLocale fl ON fl.PimCustomFieldId = f.PimCustomFieldId AND fl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE f.PimProductId = p.PimProductId ORDER BY f.DisplayOrder, f.CustomCode) f1 WHERE p.PimProductId = @product AND cf.ai IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.PimProductId
